versions.content: The Dem module shall provide the Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC to the J1939Dcm [7] for deleting all active or previously active DTCs from the event memory . This shall trigger also initializing of related SW-Cs / BSW modules according to [SWS_Dem_00003].
